text:
Your voice was a drink I sipped in silence

before astonished gazes.

a bird of light

came out of your transparent body

bird of light

an instant fluttering

at dizzying speed

crossing street after street

they pursue your fleeing body

when will you be able to drive off the maddened pack?

defenseless

you shattered yourself in falling

the remnants of your body crawl through every corner

of the world

ah one day you will be reborn

you, the transparent one

unique, unmistakable

slightly inclined, never fallen

surrounded by impenetrable silence

advancing your fragile foot through the wavering monotony

ah one day your laughter will be reborn

your transparent bird laughter

your wounded laughter.

translation.title: The Transparent Woman
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the breathless surreal sequence and the recurring transparent bird image.
